## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what this change makes happen. Link the issue.

## Validation

List the relevant checks and actual results. Include interface screenshots when useful. Explain any checks that could not run.

## Risks and compatibility

Describe migrations, contract changes, device limitations or rollout concerns. Link updated documentation. State whether the change affects authentication, filesystem access or media processing.

- [ ] Scope is focused and unrelated work is preserved.
- [ ] Documentation and public contracts match the implementation.
- [ ] Tests use isolated fixtures and do not alter live data.
- [ ] No secrets, private environment details or generated artifacts are included.

Merge, deployment and publication follow maintainer-approved gates.
